_comment: Colorado Springs, CO MSA — El Paso and Teller counties. Extracted from the Claude nine-stage workbook (methodology v2.0). NOT YET IMPORTED. expected_publish is deliberately absent: for a new metro the projected split IS the finding the owner needs, so it is reported by --stage=project rather than asserted.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the Colorado Springs MSA county list (El Paso + Teller), not the observed venue bounding box, so a legitimate future venue near the metro edge is not rejected.
msa: Colorado Springs, CO (El Paso and Teller counties)
_exclude_comment: No exclusions. The 10 probable rows are NOT excluded — they import as draft and are held by the publish gate on research_status, which is the intended mechanism.
_geocode_comment: 5 of 24 produce no coordinate from any rung and 4 more resolve only to street/city level. All 9 were investigated, not waved through: 5 carry no street address at all in the workbook (Widefield Community Park, Garden of the Gods Resort & Club, YMCA at First & Main, Windmill Mesa Park, The Warehouse via a suite address), and the low-precision 4 geocode to a street band. All 9 are blocked by the publish gate, which is correct. require_all_geocoded stays false so the batch can import as draft while those are resolved.
_reconcile_comment: 2 reconciles onto pre-existing dormant OSM draft rows. Both are draft, unverified, metro_area NULL, and predate this session. Site-wide facility_listings delta must therefore be exactly +22, not +24.

reconciles.note: STRONGEST RECONCILE IN THIS SET. Exact-address anchor: the existing OSM row already carries address 2975 New Center Point, city Colorado Springs, zip 80922 — byte-identical to the operator-published address on springspickleball.com. Independent Nominatim geocode of that address lands 10 m from the stored OSM node. Research supplies what the OSM row lacks: court_count 11, access_type private (the row currently says unknown, which FAILS the publish gate), fee_type fee, reservation_policy and booking URL. Name normalises from the OSM hyphenation "Springs Pickleball - East" to the operator form "Springs Pickleball East"; slug is unchanged either way, so no live URL moves.

Exact-ID anchor: both rows are the SAME OSM node (node/10799702072), so distance is 0 by construction and identity is not in question. RENAME REQUIRED: the OSM name "Colo Spgs Pickleball "The Warehouse" (Indoor Court)" carries an abbreviation, embedded quotes and a parenthetical, and its slug colo-spgs-pickleball-the-warehouse-indoor-court-co lacks the -city-state convention every published row uses. The research name "Colorado Springs Pickleball (The Warehouse)" produces a convention-correct slug. The row is draft and has never been published, so no live URL moves. access_type currently unknown, which FAILS the publish gate; research supplies private. Row is research_status=probable and will be held by the gate regardless — the operator About page 404s.

_expected_publish_comment: Locked from the --stage=project run of 2026-08-03 AFTER the geocode repair pass. Turns the 13/11 split from a number read off a log into a machine assertion: both project and publish fail the run on any divergence.
